title: notes-to-self-weekly-scratchpad
content:
Notes to self — weekly scratchpad
Date range: 2026-03-03 -> 2026-03-04

Quick context: juggling infra capacity work + upcoming sales demo for Dedicated. Need to lock down small set of runnable prompts and a reliable fallback plan if GPU pool is noisy. Keep this page short — actionable items and quick reminders.

TODAY (high priority)
- [ ] Finalize demo script for Redwood Dedicated (30m) — show autoscale + canary fallback flow. Use model: redwood-v1.12-quant.
    - collect 3 prompt examples: assist-chat, summarization, retrieval-augmented answer
    - verify KV cache warm-up before demo start
- [ ] Ping Samir re: temporary GPU bump for demo (requested 2x A100 -> need confirmation by EOD). Slack note: @samir "can we bump demo pool to 4 gpus Fri 9–11am?"
- [x] Draft short checklist for on-call handoff during demo (oncall, infra pager, rollback steps)
- [ ] Upload canary config to S3 and link in Confluence page

ONGOING / THIS WEEK
- Autoscaling regression: INF-234 — reproduce locally with smaller seq_len to confirm kernel fallback logic. (next: run perf test on staging with 2k tokens)
- Private quickstart doc: finish step-by-step for VPC setup + KMS notes (blockers: missing example KMS policy)
- Cost estimates: redo cost-per-token calc for quantized v1.12 vs fp16 for baseline 8k seq workload
- Follow up with SRE: investigate occasional 503s in region-us-west2 (trace id examples saved in Slack)

MEETING NOTES (standups / quick syncs)
- 03/03 Eng sync: rollout window for canary will be Tue 03/09; need safety timeout set to 2m.
- 03/04 Demo prep call with Sales: emphasize predictable latency and fallback to cheaper model variant if capacity constrained. Sales asked for SLA language sample — add to demo deck.

PERSONAL / ERRANDS (small reminders)
- Dentist appointment 2026-03-10 10:30am — confirm time in calendar
- Pick up dry cleaning (Fri)
- Grocery: milk, eggs, spinach, coffee filters
- Move gym to Sat morning if demo on Fri

NOTES TO SELF / QUICK IDEAS
- Try a 2-phase warmup: 1) short prefix warmup with cached KV, 2) synthetic load to stabilize GPU kernels before demo
- Consider adding a "budget throttle" param to canary rollout so sales demo can't spike infra cost unexpectedly
- Keep snippets small in public slides (no private keys, obfuscated dataset names)

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS
- Can we get a temporary Dedicated pool for customer demo without affecting committed capacity? (action: Samir to confirm procurement path)
- Which GitHub PR contains the canary rollback health-check changes? (suspect PR #542 — verify)

LINKS / REFERENCES (quick)
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/GPU-allocation-notes
- Jira: INF-234 (autoscale regression)
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/542
- Slack: #infra (pinned message about demo windows)

END — keep this short. Move completed items to a proper task tracker (Linear/Jira) and delete stale notes weekly.
